answer_1.quote: the ability to automatically summarize evidence from multiple studies is of high practical importance.
datasets: a large-scale dataset comprising 20K systematic reviews and 470K primary studies
answer_1.outputs: Summaries generated by BART and LongFormer models

answer_2.quote: We examine the common errors in generated summaries and the correlation of automatic metrics such as ROUGE with our evaluation results.

answer_4.quote: The first author of the paper (main annotator) judged each pair of target and generated summaries... we asked five external annotators, one of whom was a medical professional, to evaluate the quality of 40 generated summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge summaries based on binary categorical ratings for defined quality dimensions: PICO, Direction, Modality, Grammar, Spelling, Repetitions.
